text:
sanjay: Heads up — we're seeing ~15% 429s from prod gateway on /v1/generate since 12:07 UTC. Appears to target long-seq requests. I think the fast-path pool is overloaded. Need emergency routing override? :rotating_light:

ella: On it. Can we flip fast-path-off toggle and route longseq to dedicated-fallback pool? What's impact on latency?

sanjay: Latency up ~50ms but stable. If we route long-seq to dedicated-fallback cost ups, but reduces 429s. Ops runbook says use header override first before global toggle.

josie: Suggest using `x-rw-route: fallback-longseq` header override via gateway rules for matching route: `path:/v1/generate and header:content-length>10k` — can hotpatch.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Starting gateway rule patch: add header_override rule -> fallback pool (author=sanjay).

kevin: patch applied. Confirming no immediate 5xx. Watching metrics dashboard: https://console/redwood/dashboards/gateway/rate-limits

ops-bot: alert: 429 rate dropping from 15% -> 2% over last 3mins.

ella: Nice — leave rule for 30m then rollback. Add telemetry tag `emergency-reroute=1763504120` for later analysis.

sanjay: Added tag. Also logging KV: loggable_headers includes x-rw-route. Anybody want to run a canary check on high-prio customers? @marco

marco: Running smoke across 3 customers now. No errors. Perf: P95 increased by 60ms for those requests.

josie: Plan for rollback: ```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/gateway/rules/remove -d 'rule_id=hdr-override-1763504120'
``` OR use console toggle -> revert. Prefer console for audit.

ella: I'll schedule revert at 12:50 UTC if stable. If 429s creep back >5%, keep and open infra incident.

kevin: Noted. Capturing thread in incident system: INC-2026-1287

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rule removed (manual revert by ella) at 12:49:22 UTC. incident closed.

ops-bot: final: 429s normalized, cost delta ~+0.6% for fallback period. Tag retained for postmortem.
